name: BD Securities Classification Unification
description: Replace three divergent static ETF classification codebases with a single DynamoDB-backed ETFClassifier. New 'bd-securities' table (separate from Yang's 'etf-classifications') seeded with 116 Yang items then enriched with full BD securities universe via OpenAI batch classification (gpt-4o-mini). Canonical 4-bucket taxonomy: Equity / Fixed Income / Alternatives / Cash(computed residual). Sub-asset class names drawn from existing Opal vocabulary; new names only where no existing name applies. lib/etf_classifier.py shared module used by all EC2 gold scripts and Lambda. Portal MixTimeseriesPoint updated: structured_notes+cash+other -> alternatives (cash implicit). Delivered combined with GLDRST path changes in one DS session, one AE gold run.
phase: Phase 0: PRD complete, COO decomposition pending
blocking: COO task order issuance. AE_CloudOps WS1 (Terraform bd-securities table) is the hard prerequisite for all other workstreams.
